PART 1
MAN:
Hello. Do you mind if
| ask you some questions about your journey today? We’re
doing a customer satisfaction survey.
SOPHIE:
Yes. OK. I’ve got about ten minutes before my train home leaves. I'm on a day
trip.
MAN:
Great. Thank you. So first of all, could you tell me your name?
SOPHIE:
It's Sophie Bird.
MAN:
Thank you. And would you mind telling me what you do?
SOPHIE:
I'm a journalist.
Q1
MAN:
Oh really? That must be interesting.
.
SOPHIE:
Yes. It is.
;
MAN:
So was the reason for your visit here today work?
SOPHIE:
Actually, it’s my day off.
| came here to do some shopping.
Q2
MAN:
Oh right.
SOPHIE:
But | do sometimes come here for work.
:
MAN:
OK. Now I'd like to ask some questions about your journey today, if that’s OK.
SOPHIE:
Yes. No problem.
MAN:
Right, so can you tell me which station you're travelling back to?
SOPHIE:
Staunfirth, where| live.
Q3
MAN:
Can| just check the spelling? S-T-A-U-N-F-I-R-T-H?
:
SOPHIE:
That's right.
MAN:
And you travelled from there this morning?
:
SOPHIE:
Yes.
MAN:
OK, good. Next, can | ask what kind of ticket you bought? | assume it wasn't a
:
season ticket, as you don't travel every day.
SOPHIE:
That’s right. No, | just got a norma! return ticket.
| don’t have a rail card so | didn’t
Q4
get any discount.
| keep meaning to get one because it’s a lot cheaper.
MAN:
Yes — you'd have saved 20% on your ticket today. So you paid the full price for
your ticket?
SOPHIE:
| paid £23.70.
Q5
MAN:
OK. Do you think that’s good value for money?
SOPHIE:
Not really.
| think it's too much for a journey that only takes 45 minutes.
:
MAN:
Yes, that’s one of the main complaints we get. So, you didn’t buy your ticket in
advance?
|
SOPHIE:
No.
| know it's cheaper if you buy a week in advance but | didn’t know
| was
coming then.
MAN:
| know. You can't always plan ahead. So, did you buy it this morning?
SOPHIE:
No, it was yesterday.
MAN:
Right. And do you usually buy your tickets at the station?
SOPHIE:
Well,
| do usually but the ticket office closes early and | hate using ticket
machines.
| think ticket offices should be open for longer hours. There's always a
}
queue for the machines and they're often out of order.
|
MAN:
A lot of customers are saying the same thing.
SOPHIE:
So to answer your question ...
| got an e-ticket online.
Q6
MAN:
OK. Thank you. Now I'd like to ask you about your satisfaction with your journey.
So what would you say you were most satisfied with today?
